_readme: THE config file for the Biblia Tafsiri Mbalimbali agent — everything you might switch lives here. (1) FIRST RUN: open https://developers.facebook.com/tools/explorer, select your app, generate a token with pages_show_list + pages_manage_posts + pages_read_engagement (and Business use case permissions), and paste it into data/meta-token.txt (plain text, one line) — then push. The next agent run mints this page's PERMANENT token, writes it into pageAccessToken below, and clears meta-token.txt. Page tokens never expire, so this is a one-time step. (2) Pause everything: set autoPost to false (the runner reads it live; force runs still work). (3) Schedule: slots + timezone. Page: Biblia Tafsiri Mbalimbali = 447560908444853 (@biblia_tafsiri_mbalimbali). If this repo ever goes public, move these values to host env vars instead.
